edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. This revision increases the distance penalty from -0.05 to -0.08 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad, and conditions the controlled_descent_bonus on being near the pad (distance<0.2) to prevent off-pad farming. The touchdown_stability_bonus is conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.2) as well. These changes follow the phase_guidance_after_action_coverage mode by adding phase-specific guidance for the approach and touchdown phases without making bonuses one-shot (which failed previously) or tightening conditions too aggressively (which also failed).
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on distance and angle) but with tighter distance condition
touchdown_stability_bonus (repeatable, conditioned on low velocity and leg contact) but with pad proximity condition
changed_design: Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.08 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad without causing early failure (failed pattern from iter_004 used -0.1 which was too aggressive).

Tighten controlled_descent_bonus distance condition from <0.5 to <0.2 (near pad) so the bonus is only available when the lander is close to the pad. This prevents farming the bonus off-pad while being less restrictive than the failed <0.1 threshold.
Tighten touchdown_stability_bonus to require being near the pad (distance < 0.2) in addition to low velocities and leg contact. This prevents collecting the bonus off-pad.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make bonuses one-shot (failed pattern from iter_010->011): bonuses remain repeatable but with tighter conditions.
Do not increase distance penalty too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_004): increase from -0.05 to -0.08, not -0.1.
Do not tighten distance conditions too aggressively (failed pattern from iter_005->006): use <0.2 instead of <0.1.
Do not add improvement bonuses that require internal state tracking (failed pattern from iter_006->007 and iter_010->011): no internal state added.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: we tighten conditions instead.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The increased distance penalty will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The tighter conditions for bonuses will discourage staying off-pad and encourage approaching the pad.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): increased distance penalty (-0.08 * distance) provides a stronger gradient to move toward the pad. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.2) rewards using main engine when near pad and upright. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (repeatable, distance<0.2) rewards low velocity at contact near the pad. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: controlled_descent_bonus is per-step conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.2) and upright, so it encourages engine use during descent near the pad but cannot be farmed at a distance. touchdown_stability_bonus is per-step conditioned on being near the pad (distance<0.2) and low velocities, so it encourages stable touchdown on the pad. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.

lesson: A medium reward revision from behavior 'unclear_policy' to 'unclear_policy' improved fitness_score by 72.803.
